growth_boundary: New retry host content plus retained first-attempt host content plus positive guest free-space decrease from original first-attempt preflight. No old evidence deletion.
old_rule: One bounded 7200-second, 3GiB matched campaign; stop without automatic retry
new_rule: Exactly one explicitly approved retry, unchanged aggregate runtime7200s, amended aggregate retained growth6GiB including failed attempt
reason: SQLite callback-thread defect repaired with serialized cross-thread connections. Actual normalized JSON Parquet/reference overhead is larger than the initial estimate; complete retained 27-trial matrix may exceed3GiB. This is a resource amendment, not a preference threshold or input change.
unchanged: Same pinned normalized inputs, full projection/identity checks, 27 seeded trials, all timings and query definitions, VM2CPU/6GiB/64GiB, Spark local[2]/2g, reserve20GiB, guest available512MiB, source/parser/identity/fingerprint policies
input_preparation: Read-only reuse only after SHA checks of original normalized files/wrappers and exact immutable SQLite ledger count/digest; no rebuilding or mutating retained inputs
isolation: Fresh trial UUID topics/prefixes/checkpoints; original failed namespace stays unchanged
single_use: Exclusive private P20-MATCHED-RETRY-1 authorization receipt before launching the retry; failure consumes this authorization
stop: Any further failure stops campaign; no implicit third attempt, cap increase, VM change, source download or full-hour replay
scientific_consequences: First failure is preserved and excluded from accepted timing medians. Only repeated equivalent correct core trials can form engine comparisons; no production pipeline or H3 capacity claim.
